 import functools
+import typing
 import unittest
 
 
-# Add regression TestCase classes here.
+class TestUnionRegistration(unittest.TestCase):
+
+    def test_explicit_register_pipe_union_decorator(self):
+        """register(int | str) decorator form dispatches each member."""
+        @functools.singledispatch
+        def func(x):
+            return "default"
+
+        @func.register(int | str)
+        def _impl(x):
+            return "union"
+
+        self.assertEqual(func(42), "union")
+        self.assertEqual(func("hello"), "union")
+        self.assertEqual(func(3.14), "default")
+
+    def test_explicit_register_typing_union(self):
+        """register(typing.Union[int, str]) form works."""
+        @functools.singledispatch
+        def func(x):
+            return "default"
+
+        @func.register(typing.Union[int, str])
+        def _impl(x):
+            return "typed"
+
+        self.assertEqual(func(1), "typed")
+        self.assertEqual(func("a"), "typed")
+        self.assertEqual(func(None), "default")
+
+    def test_annotation_register_union(self):
+        """@register with a union annotation on the first parameter."""
+        @functools.singledispatch
+        def func(x):
+            return "default"
+
+        @func.register
+        def _impl(x: int | float):
+            return "num"
+
+        self.assertEqual(func(1), "num")
+        self.assertEqual(func(2.5), "num")
+        self.assertEqual(func("s"), "default")
+
+    def test_registry_contains_each_member(self):
+        """Each union member type is registered individually."""
+        @functools.singledispatch
+        def func(x):
+            return "default"
+
+        @func.register(int | str)
+        def _impl(x):
+            return "x"
+
+        self.assertIn(int, func.registry)
+        self.assertIn(str, func.registry)
+        self.assertIs(func.registry[int], _impl)
+        self.assertIs(func.registry[str], _impl)
+
+    def test_union_of_parameterized_generic_rejected(self):
+        """A union containing a parameterized generic raises TypeError
+        without partially modifying the registry."""
+        @functools.singledispatch
+        def func(x):
+            return "default"
+
+        # list[int] is not a runtime class; registration must be rejected.
+        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
+            func.register(typing.Union[list[int], int), lambda x: x)
+
+        # Registry should not contain the invalid member.
+        self.assertNotIn(list[int], func.registry)
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    unittest.main()
